messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the version from before the first hair color change was made and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands mostly still, then briefly looks down and touches his chest and chin before returning to a neutral standing pose.","camera":"A static, low-angle full shot captures the man from head to toe.","clothing":"He wears a light grey, long-sleeved sweater with a geometric diamond pattern, grey trousers, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair with a slightly textured top.","identity":"A young man with a slim build, short dark hair, and a light beard stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor paved road under a concrete overpass, with construction barriers, signs, and trees visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a neon-lit city street to the reference road under a concrete overpass with construction barriers and signs. The man remains centered in a static low-angle full shot and performs the same standing, looking down, and touching chest/chin actions. His lighting now appears brighter and more consistent with the outdoor overpass scene. His sweater appears grey rather than the source's light blue, and his hair appears dark rather than the source's lighter color.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference road under an overpass, place the person there, and keep identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing while adapting lighting.
uncertain: Whether the person's identity and facial features were preserved exactly, since the face is small and lighting changed.
unexpected_changes: The sweater color changed from light blue in the source to grey in the output.
The hair color appears darker in the output than in the source.
